Sample reviews by our guests (See more in the “Reviews” section):

“We’ve been visiting Seacrest for years and have always wanted to stay in this house. We finally had the opportunity and it exceeded all expectations! We are now spoiled and no other house will ever compare!” - Kim

“We have been staying at different homes in Seacrest for the past 10 years and this home is above all THE BEST!“ - Tammy

"I have been vacationing in the area for over 15 years and this is, by far, is the nicest house I have had the pleasure to stay in." - Mary S.

“We have visited Seacrest and 30A many times and this home was by far the best we have visited!” - Anne

"To repeat what the prior renters have said - this is by far the best rental home we've stayed in.” - Mary R.
—————————————
This massive, 30A custom home is one to see and enjoy:

Sleeps 12.

- Master Bedroom 1 (2nd Floor): King size bed, deluxe pillow top mattress, 50 inch smart TV, full bath, walk in shower, free standing tub, walk in closet.

- Master Bedroom 2 (3rd Floor): King size bed, deluxe pillow top mattress, 50 inch smart TV, full bath, walk in shower, large walk in closet.

- Large Bedroom 3 (1st Floor): 2 Queen size beds, deluxe pillow top mattresses, 50 inch smart TV, full bath, walk in shower, walk in closet with sliding barn door. Private deck facing wooded back yard with Adirondack chairs.

- Bedroom 4 (1st Floor): Bunk Bedroom with 4 bunk beds and 2 trundles. 50 inch smart TV, full bath, shower / tub combo, closet.

One of the largest top floor entertainment decks in all of Seacrest!
- 1100 square feet
- Faces west for a beautiful Florida sunset
- 50 Inch Big Screen smart TV
- Gas Grill
- Gas Range
- 2 hanging day beds
- 4 ceiling speakers hard wired to SONOS WIFI music streaming system. Stream music wirelessly from your phone.
- Gas Fireplace (Beautiful Custom Brick)
- 4 Ceiling Fans
- TV and Dining seating areas.
- Adjacent bar with sink, refrigerator and full size ice maker and TV.

We offer a pre-negotiated, BIKE RENTAL rate with significant discounts. LOWEST PRICE in the area.

THE BEST / MOST CONVENIENT location in Seacrest. Centrally located and short walks to EVERYTHING!

- 1 minute walk to 12,000 sq ft Seacrest pool complex. 4 homes away.

- 4 minute walk to Seacrest town square. Great shopping and dining.

- 7 minute walk to Seacrest Beach.....or a 3 minute ride on the free Seacrest tram.

Beautiful custom appointments
- 2 full size commercial ice makers.
- Oversize laundry room with 2 washers and 2 dryers
- 65 inch Sony TV in family room
- Attached "golf cart" garage - great for bike and beach gear storage
- SONOS WIFI system enables wireless music streaming from your iPhone to 4 speakers on top floor 1100 sq ft entertainment deck.
- Quartz counter tops
- Oak hardwood floors throughout
- Pecky cypress wood ceilings
- Nickle gap / ship board walls
- Stainless steel Fridgedair refrigerator, dishasher, range / oven, full size icemaker and microwave.
- Cable TV and Wifi throughout.

2 Other Large Decks
- 2nd floor large deck outside of great room/kitchen - with 2 ceiling fans, adirondack chairs, Green Egg Grill and Gas Grill.
- 1st floor large deck outside of 2 Queen Bedroom with adirondack chairs.

Check out this video of our home by Chimar Construction:
https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=0lcn_3Ni5Co
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
